subject: Civic Education
competence: Explains the need to be sensitive as a worker to the expectations of the work place.
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the need to be sensitive as a worker to the expectations of the work place.
Explains the fact that the fulfillment of the expectations of a work place is a bounden duty of an employee.
the_entrance: Let the students identify through example that any institution has its specific expectations.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Introduce the concept of work place expectations and provide examples.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will identify and discuss the expectations of different institutions.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Facilitate student group discussions on the importance of fulfilling work place expectations.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will work in groups to identify the expectations of different institutions and discuss the importance of fulfilling them.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitoring group progress and correcting misconceptions

summary: Recap the importance of fulfilling work place expectations and the need for sensitivity as a worker.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Summative check for all learning outcomes
information_sources: National Institute of Education (NIE) Teacher Instructional Guide
